mapper.select: select `id`,`user_id`,`name`,`api_key`,`key_hash`,`model`,`enabled`, date_format(`create_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime, date_format(`last_used_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastUsedTime from `wb_gateway_key` where `user_id`=#{userId} order by `id`

select `id`,`user_id`,`name`,`api_key`,`key_hash`,`model`,`enabled`, date_format(`create_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime, date_format(`last_used_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastUsedTime from `wb_gateway_key` where `id`=#{id} and `user_id`=#{userId}

select `id`,`user_id`,`name`,`api_key`,`key_hash`,`model`,`enabled`,`model_override` as modelOverride, date_format(`create_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime, date_format(`last_used_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastUsedTime from `wb_gateway_key` where `key_hash`=#{keyHash} and `enabled`=1
select count(1) as "count", COALESCE(sum(`input_tokens`),0) as "inputTokens", COALESCE(sum(`output_tokens`),0) as "outputTokens" from `wb_gateway_usage`
select count(1) as "count", COALESCE(sum(`input_tokens`),0) as "inputTokens", COALESCE(sum(`output_tokens`),0) as "outputTokens" from `wb_gateway_usage` where `create_time` >= CURDATE()

select g.`user_id` as "userId", COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`display_name`,''), u.`username`) as "ownerName", count(1) as "count", COALESCE(sum(g.`input_tokens`),0) as "inputTokens", COALESCE(sum(g.`output_tokens`),0) as "outputTokens" from `wb_gateway_usage` g left join `users` u on g.`user_id` = u.`id` group by g.`user_id`, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`display_name`,''), u.`username`) order by count(1) desc

select `used_model` as "usedModel", count(1) as "count", COALESCE(sum(`input_tokens`),0) as "inputTokens", COALESCE(sum(`output_tokens`),0) as "outputTokens" from `wb_gateway_usage` group by `used_model` order by count(1) desc

select g.`id`, g.`user_id` as "userId", COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`display_name`,''), u.`username`) as "ownerName", g.`protocol`, g.`requested_model` as "requestedModel", g.`used_model` as "usedModel", g.`stream`, g.`input_tokens` as "inputTokens", g.`output_tokens` as "outputTokens", g.`duration_ms` as "durationMs", g.`status`, g.`error_kind` as "errorKind", date_format(g.`create_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as "createTime" from `wb_gateway_usage` g left join `users` u on g.`user_id` = u.`id` order by g.`id` desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
mapper.delete: delete from `wb_gateway_usage` where `create_time` < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
mapper.select: select g.`id`, g.`user_id` as "userId", COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`display_name`,''), u.`username`) as "ownerName", g.`protocol`, g.`requested_model` as "requestedModel", g.`used_model` as "usedModel", g.`stream`, g.`input_tokens` as "inputTokens", g.`output_tokens` as "outputTokens", g.`duration_ms` as "durationMs", g.`status`, g.`error_kind` as "errorKind", date_format(g.`create_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as "createTime", g.`request_data` as "requestData", g.`response_data` as "responseData" from `wb_gateway_usage` g left join `users` u on g.`user_id` = u.`id` where g.`id` = #{id}

select k.`id`, k.`user_id` as "userId", COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`display_name`,''), u.`username`) as "ownerName", u.`username` as "username", k.`name`, k.`api_key` as "apiKey", k.`model`, k.`enabled`, k.`model_override` as "modelOverride", date_format(k.`create_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as "createTime", date_format(k.`last_used_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as "lastUsedTime" from `wb_gateway_key` k left join `users` u on k.`user_id` = u.`id` order by u.`id`, k.`id`
select `id`,`user_id` as userId,`name`,`api_key` as apiKey,`key_hash` as keyHash,`model`,`enabled`,`model_override` as modelOverride from `wb_gateway_key` where `id`=#{id}
